items.name: Gloss
items.tagline: Enamel-like depth with a deliberate shine.
items.description: High-sheen automotive paint with a polished enamel read. Best for interiors, porte-cocheres, and shaded outdoor moments where reflection is deliberate.
items.imageAlt: Glossy dark surface reflecting soft light

items.name: Matte
items.tagline: A quiet plane that lets planting lead.
items.description: A flat, non-reflective film that sits behind foliage and furniture. Pairs easily with stone, wood, linen, and brushed metals.

traits.label: Care
traits.value: Dust or rinse; marks lift with gentle detergent

items.imageAlt: Muted matte interior with plant and natural materials

items.name: Rustic
items.tagline: Hand-trowelled: ceramic soul, fraction of the weight.
items.description: A worked surface with tonal depth and visible tool movement. No two pieces are identical, which gives larger runs a more natural rhythm.

traits.label: Care
traits.value: Brush wash; reseal per project notes if exterior

items.name: Stone
items.description: A mineral treatment that suggests carved or pitched stone. Strong for landscapes, entry courts, and roof decks where the vessel should feel architectural.

traits.label: Care
traits.value: Pressure rinse ok; inspect drainage seasonally

items.name: Orange Peel
items.description: A tight dimple pattern inspired by citrus skin under raking light. Breaks glare without going flat matte and works well at hand height.

traits.label: Care
traits.value: Wipe or hose; texture hides light dust

items.imageAlt: Soft dappled light on a tactile surface

about.title: Made in India, designed for the way people actually live.

storyBlocks.title: Origin
paragraphs: LEAFO is a planter manufacturer based in Anand, Gujarat. We make fiber pots, full-size planters, and modular fiber systems for homes, commercial spaces, and landscape projects.

The company started with a simple observation: India had hundreds of pot manufacturers, but very few thinking about planters as designed objects. Most catalogues offered shape, but not silhouette. Colour, but not finish. We started LEAFO to close that gap.

storyBlocks.title: Approach
paragraphs: Every series in the catalogue is drawn before it's moulded. Sizes are chosen so that a single design works at desktop scale and architectural scale. Finishes are tested for outdoor weather over multiple seasons. Production happens in our own facility, with hand-laying, hand-finishing, and quality control done in-house.

whatWeMake: 5 finishes: gloss, matte, rustic, stone, orange peel
Built for indoor and outdoor use
Shipped across India, exported on request
about.closing: If you're an architect, designer, hotelier, or homeowner working on a space, we'd like to hear what you're planning.
